more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; flavoured drinks; food supplements supplied in a solid form, excluding food supplements for infants and young children.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.origin: Made by treating partially hydrolysed starch with a microbial cycloglycosyltransferase enzyme. The product consists of rings containing seven glucose units.
more_info.side_effects:
Refined food-use estimates exceeded the limit for several groups.
The reviewed animal studies did not indicate genotoxicity or cancer; the limit incorporates a safety margin.
more_info.overview: Beta-cyclodextrin is a cyclic carbohydrate containing seven glucose units, manufactured by an enzyme-mediated conversion of starch. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. Made by treating partially hydrolysed starch with a microbial cycloglycosyltransferase enzyme. The product consists of rings containing seven glucose units. The specified material is supplied as white crystalline material or solid. Only a limited amount dissolves in water, according to the specification.
